answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the pulse queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. The garden index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Slashing removes 34 percent at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
